import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.dataset as ds
from pyarrow import fs

key, secret, token = "ASIA...", "...", "..."   # pegar desde la página (duran 1 h)

s3 = fs.S3FileSystem(access_key=key, secret_key=secret, session_token=token, region="us-west-2")

# `year` debe declararse int64 (como en los archivos); con partitioning="hive" falla: "incompatible types"
rem = ds.dataset("do-datopia/categoria=salud/pais=cl/fuente=deis/tipo=resumen-estadistico-mensual/version=v1", filesystem=s3, format="parquet", ignore_prefixes=["dataset", "manifest"],
                 partitioning=ds.partitioning(pa.schema([("year", pa.int64())]), flavor="hive"))
print(rem.count_rows(filter=ds.field("year") == 2024))   # solo lee la carpeta year=2024/

# pip install duckdb geopandas

import duckdb
import geopandas as gpd

key, secret, token = "ASIA...", "...", "..."   # pegar desde la página (duran 1 h)

duckdb.sql(f"CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, KEY_ID '{key}', SECRET '{secret}', SESSION_TOKEN '{token}', REGION 'us-west-2')")
duckdb.execute("INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial")   # `geometry` es GeoParquet (WKB, EPSG:4326)

# Filtrar en DuckDB (una hora + una caja) y traer a geopandas solo el resultado: un día son ~10 M de puntos
df = duckdb.sql("""
    SELECT plate, speed, ST_X(geometry) AS lon, ST_Y(geometry) AS lat
    FROM 's3://do-datopia/categoria=transporte/pais=cl/fuente=red-movilidad/tipo=posicion-diaria/version=v1/year=2025/month=10/day=15/part-*.parquet'
    WHERE timestamp_gps_utc BETWEEN '2025-10-15 12:00' AND '2025-10-15 13:00'
      AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-70.67, -33.46, -70.63, -33.42))   -- centro de Santiago
""").df()
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(df.lon, df.lat), crs="EPSG:4326")
print(gdf.head())

# install.packages(c("duckdb", "DBI", "sf"))

library(DBI)
library(sf)

key <- "ASIA..."; secret <- "..."; token <- "..."   # pegar desde la página (duran 1 h)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
dbExecute(con, sprintf("CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, KEY_ID '%s', SECRET '%s', SESSION_TOKEN '%s', REGION 'us-west-2')", key, secret, token))
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial")
dbExecute(con, "LOAD spatial")   # `geometry` es GeoParquet (WKB, EPSG:4326)

# Filtrar en DuckDB (una hora + una caja) y traer a sf solo el resultado: un día son ~10 M de puntos
df <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT plate, speed, ST_X(geometry) AS lon, ST_Y(geometry) AS lat
    FROM 's3://do-datopia/categoria=transporte/pais=cl/fuente=red-movilidad/tipo=posicion-diaria/version=v1/year=2025/month=10/day=15/part-*.parquet'
    WHERE timestamp_gps_utc BETWEEN '2025-10-15 12:00' AND '2025-10-15 13:00'
      AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-70.67, -33.46, -70.63, -33.42))   -- centro de Santiago
")
st_as_sf(df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

using HTTP, JSON3

url = "https://ee98cnfz7e.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod"
sesion = JSON3.read(HTTP.post("$url/auth/login", ["Content-Type" => "application/json"],
    JSON3.write(Dict("email" => "tu-email@ejemplo.com", "password" => "tu-contraseña"))).body)

con = DBInterface.connect(DuckDB.DB, ":memory:")
DBInterface.execute(con, "CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, KEY_ID '$key', SECRET '$secret', SESSION_TOKEN '$token', REGION 'us-west-2')")

resultado = DataFrame(DBInterface.execute(con, """
    SELECT count(*) AS mediciones FROM 's3://do-datopia/categoria=medio-fisico/pais=cl/fuente=sinca/tipo=medicion-diaria/version=v1/part-*.parquet' WHERE year >= 2020"""))
println(resultado)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Requiere el CLI de DuckDB, curl y jq

URL="https://ee98cnfz7e.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod"
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "$URL/auth/login" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "tu-email@ejemplo.com", "password": "tu-contraseña"}' | jq -r .id_token)
CRED=$(curl -s -X POST "$URL/auth/session/s3" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN")
KEY_ID=$(jq -r .access_key_id <<<"$CRED") SECRET=$(jq -r .secret_access_key <<<"$CRED") SESSION_TOKEN=$(jq -r .session_token <<<"$CRED")

duckdb -c "
CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, KEY_ID '$KEY_ID', SECRET '$SECRET', SESSION_TOKEN '$SESSION_TOKEN', REGION 'us-west-2');
SELECT count(*) AS mediciones FROM 's3://do-datopia/categoria=medio-fisico/pais=cl/fuente=sinca/tipo=medicion-diaria/version=v1/part-*.parquet' WHERE year >= 2020;"
